source_text: Klagel. Jerem. 4, 15. Δηλοῖ δὲ τὸ μὲν ἀνήφθησαν τὸ τῆς ἁλώσεως πῦρ, τὸ δὲ ἐσαλεύθησαν τὴν εἰς δουλείαν μετάστασιν , τὸ δὲ οὐ μὴ προσ- θῶσι τοῦ παροικεῖν ὅτι διηνεκῆ σχήσουσι παροικίαν, δεττέρας μηκέτι δεόμενοι.
pass_a_gloss: [Pass A] And “they were kindled” shows the fire of the capture, and “they were shaken” the transfer unto slavery, and “they will not add to sojourn” that they will have a continuous sojourn, no longer needing a second.
pass_b_english: And “they were kindled” shows the fire of the capture, and “they were shaken” the transfer unto slavery, and “they will not add to sojourn” that they will have a continuous sojourn, no longer needing a second.

choices.why: 2 Cor 3 veil reading of Lam 4:20 ‘spirit of our face’.

anf_compare.notes: No public-domain English of Origen’s Greek Lamentations fragments. Sense checked against Klostermann GCS III. Modern English not copied. OET = no previous English translation.
